pr_title: sql: populate role valid until fields in pg_catalog tables
pr_body:
Fixes #49420.

Previously, the `rolvaliduntil` value was always `NULL` for `pg_roles` and `pg_authid`.

Release note (bug fix): Correctly populate rolvaliduntil value for roles in pg_roles and pg_authid.

issue_context.title: sql: populate role valid until fields in pg_catalog tables
issue_context.body:
Populate `rolvaliduntil` in pg_catalog tables.

Right now, `rolvaliduntil` is always NULL in pg_catalog.pg_roles and pg_catalog.authid.

Example: test does not have rolvaliduntil value in pg_catalog.pg_roles as '2021-01-01'.

Should be an easy fix similar to #49207.
```
root@127.0.0.1:50287/movr> CREATE USER test VALID UNTIL '2021-01-01';
sCREATE ROLE

Time: 3.72ms

root@127.0.0.1:50287/movr> SELECT * FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles;
     oid     | rolname | rolsuper | rolinherit | rolcreaterole | rolcreatedb | rolcatupdate | rolcanlogin | rolreplication | rolconnlimit | rolpassword | rolvaliduntil | rolbypassrls | rolconfig
-------------+---------+----------+------------+---------------+-------------+--------------+-------------+----------------+--------------+-------------+---------------+--------------+------------
  2310524507 | admin   |   true   |    true    |     true      |    true     |    false     |    true     |     false      |           -1 | ********    | NULL          |    false     | NULL
  1546506610 | root    |   true   |   false    |     true      |    true     |    false     |    true     |     false      |           -1 | ********    | NULL          |    false     | NULL
  4118688310 | test    |  false   |   false    |     false     |    false    |    false     |    true     |     false      |           -1 | ********    | NULL          |    false     | NULL
(3 rows)
```

review_comments: Can you add an explicit check for if the is DNULL and then raise an error if the type is neither TimestampTz or Null.
